name: Real-World-SQL-Bench-Databases
description: A collection of real‑world database schemas and associated resources intended for evaluating text‑to‑SQL / SQL generation systems on realistic, complex schemas. The benchmark emphasizes execution correctness on real databases and is used to test how well models generalize to practical, heterogeneous schemas and noisy real‑world data. Evaluation typically focuses on whether generated queries produce the correct results when executed against the target database.
evaluation_method: execution_accuracy (query result match) and SQL exact_match as a secondary metric
reputation: Publicly available on Hugging Face and used by some text‑to‑SQL researchers to evaluate performance on real schemas; adoption is useful but less widespread than large synthetic/textual benchmarks.
